SELECTED_INDEX: 4
CONFIDENCE: 0.68
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong band at ~1130 cm⁻¹ consistent with an aryl C–F stretch and another very strong band at ~670 cm⁻¹ indicative of an aryl C–Cl stretch; only candidate 4 contains both F and Cl on an aromatic ring. The strong 1677 cm⁻¹ band fits a conjugated aldehyde C=O, and the 1586 cm⁻¹ band is a typical aromatic C=C stretch. Out-of-plane C–H bands at 696/763/847 cm⁻¹ support a trisubstituted benzene, matching an aldehyde plus F and Cl substituents.
